data.explanation: This is a service provider's bill for helping you register your address, open a bank account and get a tax ID. You need to pay the total of €1,190.00 by bank transfer to the account shown, quoting the invoice number, by the deadline shown (30 days after the invoice date). If you already paid or dispute the amount, contact the provider directly; the letter does not mention any consequence for late payment, but invoices are usually followed by a reminder (Mahnung) if unpaid. Keep this invoice, as settling-in/moving costs can sometimes be relevant for your tax return if linked to a job-related relocation.
